lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: If you are from Strand's office you can tell him the answer is the same answer, and if you are not, you are trespassing, so it does not matter who you are.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Seven to two. You lost the vote on publishing the weights.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: The vote is Thursday. It has not happened.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: ...Say that again. Say the number again.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: Seven to two, and I am one of the two, and you knew it before Thursday. Right. I am going to stop asking who you are and start asking what you want.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: It is published. Somebody put nine pages and five signatures in front of the press on the morning of the vote and the room could not hold. Whatever else happens to me, that happened.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: I keep expecting to feel further away from my own century. Ask me again in a few days.
